top_categories.workout_context: KowTown Gravel's Colorado Rockies gravel rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
KowTown Gravel's Hard-packed county roads, High-country ranch roads forces constant power changes. Surge over the rough stuff, settle on the smooth, repeat for 88 miles.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of KowTown Gravel. Train it until it feels boring.
Race-pace efforts that mimic KowTown Gravel's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before June.
At KowTown Gravel, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
When someone attacks on Colorado Rockies gravel, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
At mile 60 of 88, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 88 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.
Two threshold sessions per week without the recovery cost of VO2max work. For 88 miles, sustainable FTP gains matter more than peak power.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At KowTown Gravel, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
Tempo is KowTown Gravel's race pace. The wattage you'll hold for 88 miles on Colorado Rockies gravel. Train it until it's automatic.
Varied gradients on Colorado Rockies gravel demand climbing versatility. Sit the shallow stuff, stand the steep stuff, switch without thinking.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for KowTown Gravel’s 88 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.
race_overlay.altitude: Moderate altitude at KowTown Gravel. Arrive 2–3 days early. Reduce intensity expectations by 5–10%. Hydrate aggressively.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at KowTown Gravel requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on colorado rockies gravel to build confidence. Expect: hard-packed county roads, high-country ranch roads, doubletrack.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on TT Threshold, Gravel Specific, and G Spot to prepare you for 88 miles of colorado rockies gravel in Kremmling, Colorado.
